create_validation_issues_tracker: create an InputDataValidationIssues instance to track empty, format, and range errors across data fields
get_errors_validation: get a dictionary of validation errors including empty counts, format errors, and range violations for all fields
get_warnings_validation: get a dictionary of validation warnings for non-required fields and timestamp range issues
merge_validation_issues: merge another InputDataValidationIssues instance counters into the current instance to aggregate results
count_empty_field: increment the empty field counter for a given field name during input data validation
